apps.name: Quill
apps.subtitle: On-device iOS signer and installer
apps.localizedDescription: Quill signs and installs iOS apps on your device.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Quill checks your sources for app updates when it opens (at most every 6 hours) and tells you when new versions are available. Show opens the Library. Can be turned off in Settings.
- Optional background notification for app updates (off by default). iOS decides when background checks run, so notifications can be late.
- New step-by-step idevice setup guide (pairing file, LocalDevVPN, installation type), linked from Tunnel & Pairing, Installation settings and the self-install alert, including a way to update without a computer.
- iPad: source tabs in the sidebar select correctly.

- Share-sheet import needs Quill's bundle ID to match its provisioning profile's App ID. Settings now warns when they differ and explains how to switch.
- When Quill signs itself, it asks which bundle ID to use (profile ID or current ID) instead of filling one in, and explains why the profile ID is needed.
- Other apps can no longer silently take Quill's bundle ID; doing it manually shows a warning and an extra confirmation before install.
- Bulk signing skips Quill; sign Quill on its own to choose its bundle ID.
